experiment_title: Illumina HiSeq 2500 sequencing: GSM2758639: PAR-CLIP_RNAPII_4SU_r1 Homo sapiens RIP-Seq
study_title: Eviction of repressor PRC1 via RNA-binding of PHC1 promotes stress-induced transcription
description: Illumina HiSeq 2500 sequencing: GSM2758639: PAR-CLIP_RNAPII_4SU_r1 Homo sapiens RIP-Seq
library_construction_protocol: 300e6 HEK293T cells with overnight 4SU incubation were washed once in cold PBS and crosslinked at 365nm and a total energy of 0.15 J/cm2. Cells were scraped and resuspended in cold PBS. After centrifugation at 500 rcf for 5 minutes, pellet was resuspended in lysis buffer (50 mM HEPES pH 7.5, 150 mM KCl, 5 mM CaCl2, 1 % NP-40) and incubated 15 minutes on ice. Lysate was treated with 20 U/mL Fermentas RNase T1 and 15 U/mL Fermentase RNase free DNase I for 15 minutes at RT and then sonicated for 15 cycles (30 sec on / off) on a Diagenode Bioruptor on high. Lysate was cleared at 21’000 rcf and 4 °C for 10 minutes. IP was performed for 3 hours with 100 uL streptavidin magnetic myONE T1 beads (Thermo Fisher). Beads were washed 3 times in lysis buffer and treated with RNase T in 100 uL at 20 U/uL for 15 minutes at RT. After three more lysis buffer and two dephosphorylation buffer washes (50 mM Tris-HCl pH 7.9, 100 mM NaCl, 10 mM MgCl2) RNA was dephosphorylated at 37 °C in 100 uL NEB buffer 3 with 0.5 U / uL CIP for 10 minutes. 500 uL lysis buffer were added for beads to rebind during 10 minutes on ice. Three more lysis buffer washes and two PNK-buffer (70 mM Tris-HCl, pH 7.6, 10 mM MgCl2) washes were followed by phosphorylation with radioactive 32P at 37 °C in 100 uL of PNK buffer with 5 mM DTT, 17 nM (10 uCi) 32P-ATP and 0.5 U/uL PNK. After 30 minutes 5 uM normal ATP were added for additional 5 minutes. 1 mL of lysis buffer was added and beads are allowed to rebind during 10 minutes on ice. Beads were washed 5 times with lysis buffer, boiled in SDS-DTT solution and run on a NuPage Novex 4-12 % bis-tris gel for 1.5 hours at 150 V in MOPS buffer. Gel was imaged for 30 minutes with a phosphorimaging cassette and bands of interest excised. Elution of Protein-RNA complex was performed three times in 400 uL MOPS buffer using d-tube dialyzer midi MWCO 3.5 kDa each for 1 hours at 100 V and 5 minutes at 100 V reversed polarity. All subsequent steps were carried out exactly as described Hafner M. et al 2010. Library was prepared similary to Illumina small RNA protocol. We adhered to Hafner et al 2010.

experiment_title: NextSeq 500 sequencing: GSM2758643: ChIP-Seq_PHC1_r1 Homo sapiens ChIP-Seq
study_title: Eviction of repressor PRC1 via RNA-binding of PHC1 promotes stress-induced transcription
description: NextSeq 500 sequencing: GSM2758643: ChIP-Seq_PHC1_r1 Homo sapiens ChIP-Seq
library_construction_protocol: HEK293T cells were cultured to 80-90% confluence, reaching approximately 30 million cells per 15 cm plate. The plate was washed once with PBS before adding 10 mL of fixative solution (50 mM HEPES pH 7.5 at 25 °C, 100 mM NaCl, 1 mM EDTA, 0.5 mM EGTA, 0.1 M NaHCO3, 1% Formaldehyde Methanol free – Thermo Fisher Scientific) and incubating for 6 minutes at 25 °C while shaking gently. Directly afterwards, glycine was added to 125 mM and the plate was incubated for an additional 5 minutes. Cells were scraped off, pelleted at 4 °C, resuspended in 5 mL PBS and 15 mL water and 5 mL 5x nuclear isolation buffer (1.28 M sucrose, 40 mM Tris pH 8 at 4 °C, 20 mM MgCl2, 5 mM EDTA, 2.5 mM EGTA, 4% Triton X100, 1 µg/mL each for Leupeptin, Pepstatin A, Aprotinin) were added. The resulting suspension was rotated at 4 °C for 10 minutes. Nuclei were pelleted and resuspended in 1 mL of sonication buffer (10 mM Tris pH 8 at 4 °C, 1 mM EDTA, 0.1 % SDS, Roche cOmplete protease inhibitors) kept on ice for 5 minutes, transferred to a milliTube (Covaris) and sonicated in a S220 (Covaris) for 12 minutes at 5 % duty cycle, 200 cycles per burst and 140 W max incidence power. Sample was diluted with 250 µL 5x ChIP dilution buffer (10 mM Tris pH 8 at 4 °C, 1 mM EDTA, 0.1 % SDS, 750 mM NaCl, 5 % Triton X-100, 0.5 % Na-Deoxycholate, Roche cOmplete protease inhibitors). The mix was kept on ice for 5 minutes and cleared at maximum speed in a tabletop centrifuge. The supernatant was transferred, aliquoted and flash frozen in siliconized epis using liquid nitrogen. For each IP one aliquot was thawed on ice and pre-cleared with 10 µL of protein A or G dynabeads (Thermo Fisher Scientific) washed three times with wash buffer (10 mM Tris pH 8, 1 mM EDTA, 150 mM NaCl, 1 % Triton X-100, 0.1 % SDS, 0.1 % Na-Deoxycholate). After 15 minutes at 4 °C the beads were removed and 2 µg of the respective antibody added. The IP was performed overnight at 4 °C while rotating. Next 10 µL of washed protein A or G dynabeads were added and incubated at 4 °C for 4 hours. After the IP the beads were washed 5 times with 400 µL of wash buffer, once with 400 µL high salt wash buffer (10 mM Tris pH 8, 1 mM EDTA, 500 mM NaCl, 1 % Triton X-100, 0.1 % SDS, 0.1 % Na-Deoxycholate) and once with 400 µL TE, each for 8 minutes at 4 °C. Next the Protein-DNA was eluted from the beads by resuspending the them in 100 µL elution buffer (1 % SDS, 100 mM NaHCO3) and incubated at 65 °C and 1000 rpm in a thermomixer. The elution was repeated twice and to the resulting 300 µL eluate 12 µL 5 M NaCl were added and de-crosslinked at 65 °C overnight. To remove RNA from the de-crosslinked DNA, 8 µL of RNase A (Roche) was added and the sample was incubated for 1.5 hours at 37 °C. Afterwards, 3 µL of 20 mg / mL Proteinase K (Roche) was added and incubated at 55 °C for 1 hour. The DNA was purified using QIAquick PCR purification kit (Qiagen). Kapa Hyper Prep

After centrifugation at 500 rcf for 5 minutes, pellet was resuspended in lysis buffer (50 mM HEPES pH 7.5, 150 mM KCl, 5 mM CaCl2, 1 % NP-40) and incubated 15 minutes on ice. Lysate was treated with 20 U/mL Fermentas RNase T1 and 15 U/mL Fermentase RNase free DNase I for 15 minutes at RT and then sonicated for 15 cycles (30 sec on / off) on a Diagenode Bioruptor on high. Lysate was cleared at 21’000 rcf and 4 °C for 10 minutes. IP was performed for 3 hours with 100 uL streptavidin magnetic myONE T1 beads (Thermo Fisher). Beads were washed 3 times in lysis buffer and treated with RNase T in 100 uL at 20 U/uL for 15 minutes at RT. After three more lysis buffer and two dephosphorylation buffer washes (50 mM Tris-HCl pH 7.9, 100 mM NaCl, 10 mM MgCl2) RNA was dephosphorylated at 37 °C in 100 uL NEB buffer 3 with 0.5 U / uL CIP for 10 minutes. 500 uL lysis buffer were added for beads to rebind during 10 minutes on ice. Three more lysis buffer washes and two PNK-buffer (70 mM Tris-HCl, pH 7.6, 10 mM MgCl2) washes were followed by phosphorylation with radioactive 32P at 37 °C in 100 uL of PNK buffer with 5 mM DTT, 17 nM (10 uCi) 32P-ATP and 0.5 U/uL PNK. After 30 minutes 5 uM normal ATP were added for additional 5 minutes. 1 mL of lysis buffer was added and beads are allowed to rebind during 10 minutes on ice. Beads were washed 5 times with lysis buffer, boiled in SDS-DTT solution and run on a NuPage Novex 4-12 % bis-tris gel for 1.5 hours at 150 V in MOPS buffer. Gel was imaged for 30 minutes with a phosphorimaging cassette and bands of interest excised. Elution of Protein-RNA complex was performed three times in 400 uL MOPS buffer using d-tube dialyzer midi MWCO 3.5 kDa each for 1 hours at 100 V and 5 minutes at 100 V reversed polarity. All subsequent steps were carried out exactly as described Hafner M. et al 2010. Library was prepared similary to Illumina small RNA protocol. We adhered to Hafner et al 2010.

library_construction_protocol: HEK293T cells were cultured to 80-90% confluence, reaching approximately 30 million cells per 15 cm plate. The plate was washed once with PBS before adding 10 mL of fixative solution (50 mM HEPES pH 7.5 at 25 °C, 100 mM NaCl, 1 mM EDTA, 0.5 mM EGTA, 0.1 M NaHCO3, 1% Formaldehyde Methanol free – Thermo Fisher Scientific) and incubating for 6 minutes at 25 °C while shaking gently. Directly afterwards, glycine was added to 125 mM and the plate was incubated for an additional 5 minutes. Cells were scraped off, pelleted at 4 °C, resuspended in 5 mL PBS and 15 mL water and 5 mL 5x nuclear isolation buffer (1.28 M sucrose, 40 mM Tris pH 8 at 4 °C, 20 mM MgCl2, 5 mM EDTA, 2.5 mM EGTA, 4% Triton X100, 1 µg/mL each for Leupeptin, Pepstatin A, Aprotinin) were added. The resulting suspension was rotated at 4 °C for 10 minutes. Nuclei were pelleted and resuspended in 1 mL of sonication buffer (10 mM Tris pH 8 at 4 °C, 1 mM EDTA, 0.1 % SDS, Roche cOmplete protease inhibitors) kept on ice for 5 minutes, transferred to a milliTube (Covaris) and sonicated in a S220 (Covaris) for 12 minutes at 5 % duty cycle, 200 cycles per burst and 140 W max incidence power. Sample was diluted with 250 µL 5x ChIP dilution buffer (10 mM Tris pH 8 at 4 °C, 1 mM EDTA, 0.1 % SDS, 750 mM NaCl, 5 % Triton X-100, 0.5 % Na-Deoxycholate, Roche cOmplete protease inhibitors). The mix was kept on ice for 5 minutes and cleared at maximum speed in a tabletop centrifuge. The supernatant was transferred, aliquoted and flash frozen in siliconized epis using liquid nitrogen. For each IP one aliquot was thawed on ice and pre-cleared with 10 µL of protein A or G dynabeads (Thermo Fisher Scientific) washed three times with wash buffer (10 mM Tris pH 8, 1 mM EDTA, 150 mM NaCl, 1 % Triton X-100, 0.1 % SDS, 0.1 % Na-Deoxycholate). After 15 minutes at 4 °C the beads were removed and 2 µg of the respective antibody added. The IP was performed overnight at 4 °C while rotating. Next 10 µL of washed protein A or G dynabeads were added and incubated at 4 °C for 4 hours. After the IP the beads were washed 5 times with 400 µL of wash buffer, once with 400 µL high salt wash buffer (10 mM Tris pH 8, 1 mM EDTA, 500 mM NaCl, 1 % Triton X-100, 0.1 % SDS, 0.1 % Na-Deoxycholate) and once with 400 µL TE, each for 8 minutes at 4 °C. Next the Protein-DNA was eluted from the beads by resuspending the them in 100 µL elution buffer (1 % SDS, 100 mM NaHCO3) and incubated at 65 °C and 1000 rpm in a thermomixer. The elution was repeated twice and to the resulting 300 µL eluate 12 µL 5 M NaCl were added and de-crosslinked at 65 °C overnight. To remove RNA from the de-crosslinked DNA, 8 µL of RNase A (Roche) was added and the sample was incubated for 1.5 hours at 37 °C. Afterwards, 3 µL of 20 mg / mL Proteinase K (Roche) was added and incubated at 55 °C for 1 hour. The DNA was purified using QIAquick PCR purification kit (Qiagen). Kapa Hyper Prep
